data_gaps.reason: Live maintenance possession requisitions and divisional block grant logs reside within internal Indian Railways intranet systems (BDMS - Block Demand & Management System, TMS - Track Management System, and COA - Control Office Application). Public access to live control office block registers is restricted for operational safety and security.
data_gaps.impact_on_trackmeld: TrackMeld will model real operational possession windows deterministically using the real timetables and statutory rules extracted in Phase 0. Actual historical possession logs for calibration must be synthetic or user-provided under lawful agreement.
data_gaps.replacement: Deterministic possession window derivation from scheduled train headways + synthetic possession requests adhering to IRPWM/ACTM rules.

data_gaps.reason: Real-time block section axle-counter occupancy and signal aspects are confidential internal train control data streamed to Divisional Control Offices and not exposed via public APIs.
data_gaps.impact_on_trackmeld: TrackMeld uses published timetable schedules as the baseline for train passes. Real-time deviation/delay models will be simulated in subsequent phases.
data_gaps.replacement: Scheduled timetable movements as extracted from official Railway Board TAG publication.

data_gaps.reason: Ultrasonic Flaw Detection (USFD) defect registers and Track Recording Car (TRC) raw sensor runs are internal engineering records of divisional P-Way offices.
data_gaps.impact_on_trackmeld: Maintenance task urgency scores will be generated from realistic engineering condition models rather than actual defect logs.
data_gaps.replacement: Synthetic task feature generation mapped to real extracted block sections.
